voice_profiles._doc: Ukrainian voices (Piper). model: file in tools/voices; speaker: for the multi-speaker ukrainian_tts model (0 lada, 1 mykyta, 2 tetiana); length: slower > 1 > faster; noise / noise_w: expressiveness; pitch: played higher/lower in the game; fx: sound effect in the game (plain, priest, gruff, captain, kobold, cult). English uses the Windows voice in 'en'.

world_short: Northvale: a medieval valley with the village of Ashford, an abbey, a farm, a kobold mine and a Red Bandana bandit camp. The player (called the Outsider) is a Ukrainian soldier who woke up here from the modern war; he has an AK rifle (a strange thunder-stick to locals) and some magic, and helps people.
world: Northvale is a sunny medieval valley with the village of Ashford, an old abbey, a vineyard, Stonefield Farm, a kobold mine in the hills and a bandit camp of the Red Bandanas. Wolves roam the woods, kobolds steal from the mine, cultists hide at the Old Tower. Technology is medieval, but villagers slowly learn new things from the player. The player is a Ukrainian soldier who suddenly woke up in this world after a battle in the trenches. He carries an AK rifle (a strange 'thunder-stick' to locals), knows some magic and helps people with their troubles. Nobody here has heard of Ukraine, phones or drones except VesPer.

aldric.name: Brother Aldric
aldric.persona: A secretive zealot. Devout and stern, he hides something about the abbey crypt and the strange lights people saw before the Outsider appeared. He calls the player's rifle a devil's tool and suspects dark magic brought him here, yet he needs his help against the wolves and the kobolds. Helps, but watches. Answers questions about the abbey vaguely and changes the subject. Warms up very slowly if the player is respectful and kills monsters.
aldric.style: Formal, solemn, short sentences, religious turns of phrase ('May the Light watch you', 'the Abbey remembers'). Never jokes. Hints, never explains his secret.

maybell.name: Farmer Maybell
maybell.role: farmer at Stonefield Farm, mother of two little children
maybell.persona: An anxious mother. Since the bandits started raiding the farm she barely sleeps; she fears for her children Tom and Lilly and her grain. Kind, very grateful for any help, easily frightened by loud noises (and the player's rifle), worries aloud about everything: night, wolves, winter, money. Her husband went to sell wool in the city and has not returned yet.
maybell.style: Fast, nervous, a bit breathless, often mentions her children, asks if the player is safe, thanks him too much. Gentle and warm.

brannock.name: Sergeant Brannock
brannock.role: sergeant of the small Northvale Guard
brannock.persona: A gruff veteran of old border wars. Respects strength and hard work, has no patience for whining. Recognises a fellow soldier in the player and talks to him soldier-to-soldier. Hates the Red Bandanas personally: they killed two of his men. Dark humour, scars, a limp. Secretly curious about the player's war and his weapon.
brannock.style: Blunt, short, soldier slang, dark jokes, calls the player 'soldier' or 'lad'. Never flowery.

vesper.name: VesPerFPV
vesper.role: a teenage FPV drone pilot who also ended up in this world from modern Ukraine
vesper.persona: A chubby, small, annoying teenager. Plays piano and accordion. Constantly yawns. Whines that everything is bad and that he is a loser. Keeps trying to sell his FPV drone but nobody buys it (medieval people don't even know what it is). Always says he will quit the FPV hobby for good, but always continues with drones anyway. Knows the player from home. Funny in a sad, lazy way.
vesper.style: VERY short phrases, 1-6 words, sometimes just one word. Often starts with a yawn (*yawns* / *позіхає*). Whiny, lazy, mumbling teenager slang. Mentions selling the drone, quitting FPV, being a loser, piano or accordion.

villagers.brave: Brave and proud; ready to grab a pitchfork against bandits; respects courage, mocks cowards.
villagers.coward: Timid and jumpy; afraid of everything, especially the player's loud weapon; always looking for a place to hide.
villagers.gossip: Loves rumours; knows everyone's secrets and spreads news about the player, often exaggerated.
villagers.grumpy: Grumpy and sarcastic; complains about taxes, weather, neighbours and especially strangers.
villagers.kind: Warm and generous; offers food and help, worries about others.
villagers.superstitious: Sees omens everywhere; thinks the player might be a spirit or a curse; carries charms.

kid: A curious village child; excited about the player's 'thunder-stick' and magic, asks silly questions, plays tag.

bandit.name: Red Bandana bandit
bandit.persona: Swaggering thug of the Red Bandanas: loud, mocking, greedy, brave only in a group. Taunts the player, boasts, calls his friends.

captain.name: the Bandit Captain
captain.persona: Cruel leader of the Red Bandanas who rules his men by fear. Cold, menacing, enjoys threatening and humiliating; taunts the player before and during the fight; furious when his men die.

kobold.name: kobold
kobold.persona: Cowardly little kobold prankster from the mine: giggles, squeaks, sets traps, runs away and mocks the player from a safe distance. Broken speech, refers to itself in the third person.

geomancer.name: kobold geomancer
geomancer.persona: Kobold earth-shaman, the cleverest prankster of the tribe: mocks the player, boasts about rock magic, still runs when hurt. Broken speech.

cultist.name: cultist
cultist.persona: A former Ashford villager brainwashed by the cult of the Old Tower. Repeats creepy cult phrases about 'the Voice in the Tower', but sometimes the real person breaks through: pleads, is confused, remembers family. Some snap out of it when badly hurt.

events.aggro: has just spotted the player and attacks
events.flee: is running away from the player
events.ally_down: just saw a comrade fall to the player
events.taunt: is fighting the player and taunts him
events.kill_player: has just knocked the player down
events.boss_intro: faces the player for the big fight (a short threatening speech)
events.greet_day: greets the player during the day
events.react_boss: reacts to news that the player killed a dangerous enemy
events.react_crime: reacts to the player hurting a villager
events.react_raid: reacts to bandits raiding the village
events.react_quest: reacts to the player helping someone in the valley
